name: When should I choose custom cabinetry over semi-custom options?

mainEntity.name: When should I choose custom cabinetry over semi-custom options?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should decide on custom cabinetry if your room has non-standard dimensions, awkward angles, or unique storage needs that standard catalog sizes cannot solve. It is also the ideal choice if you want your cabinetry to integrate seamlessly with custom architectural trim, run flush to non-standard ceiling heights, or conceal specialized appliances. If your remodel involves reconfiguring walls or opening up a floor plan, custom units give your contractor the freedom to design a layout without factory dimension constraints.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose custom cabinetry when dealing with irregular room dimensions, non-standard ceiling heights, or when you need specialized built-in storage solutions.
